## 行程

### 中午 / 下午
* [大谿山 豪徳寺](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Gōtoku-ji/@35.6488124,139.6449007,17z/data=!3m2!4b1!5s0x60185ef77a4d3569:0xc953b3e0a8468c85!4m6!3m5!1s0x6018f39f99015555:0x6b0e9ad51be4cac!8m2!3d35.6488124!4d139.647481!16s%2Fg%2F122r_g9j?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=0a890b71-8d36-4b41-aada-584a3f386755)

### 晚上: 入住品川王子大飯店
* 返回品川王子辦理 Check-in 入住。
* [MoN 高輪](https://www.google.com/maps/place/MoN+Takanawa:The+Museum+of+Narratives/@35.6396988,139.7392429,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x60188b47f5754987:0xf4b17479dd0b37a5!8m2!3d35.6396988!4d139.7418178!16s%2Fg%2F11yb70qgj2?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgyNS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) (10am - 9pm)
  * 博物館, [官網](https://montakanawa.jp/zh-CHT/)
* [NEWoMan 高輪](https://www.google.com/maps/place/NEWoMan+TAKANAWA/@35.6348851,139.7394808,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x60188b007d8eedfb:0x1da733ac28f7b737!8m2!3d35.6348851!4d139.7394808!16s%2Fg%2F11x0gh_lnx!18m1!1e1?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) (11am - 8pm)
* 逛品川站內 [ecute 品川購物商場](https://www.google.com/maps/place/ecute+Shinagawa/@35.6285804,139.7394122,17z/data=!3m1!5s0x60188a5a7a6d06ed:0x7a0e1c738ff9b236!4m6!3m5!1s0x60188a5a63126889:0x54a7a1aeee962885!8m2!3d35.6285804!4d139.7394122!16s%2Fg%2F1v_z49l0?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)與美食街。
